_maintainer_note: Optional notes on rows of apis.json, kept beside it so its snapshot vectors stay as they are. time_base: each answer row's moment is the answer's own start time (start, read with format, in zone) plus the row's offset field in unit; the made view shows it in the owner's own time. value_words: words for a field's scale values, as [upper bound, words] steps, lowest first (from the service's own documentation).
